title: No-Firecracker Pledge Walk
description: Join us for a community walk to raise awareness about the harmful effects of firecrackers on air quality. We'll distribute leaflets and plant small saplings at the end.
what_to_bring: Comfortable walking shoes, water bottle, face mask
ward_banner: Ward 56 (Lodhi Colony) has high dust levels this week. Join a drive this weekend!

title: Biomass Burning Watch
description: Help monitor and report incidents of garbage and leaf burning in Anand Vihar area. We will record violations and submit a report to the local municipality.
place: Anand Vihar Metro Station, Exit 2, Delhi
what_to_bring: Camera or smartphone, N95 mask, notebook

title: Free N95 Mask Distribution
description: Free N95 mask distribution for daily-wage workers, auto-rickshaw drivers, and street vendors. Each participant gets 5 masks and a quick health talk.
place: Connaught Place Inner Circle, New Delhi

title: Construction Dust Awareness Drive
description: A drive to educate construction site managers and workers about dust-control measures mandated by the National Green Tribunal. Covers water spraying, covering materials, and vehicle wheel washing.

title: School Air Quality Workshop
description: An interactive workshop for school students (classes 6–10) covering what AQI means, how to read an AQI report, and simple actions they can take to help.
place: Lajpat Nagar Community Hall, South Delhi
